description: This file defines data structures, filtering mechanisms, and utility functions related to the execution of agent workflows, including the Execution entity, filters, DAG edge representations, and associated helper functions.

classes.name: Execution
classes.description: Represents a single agent invocation within a workflow, including identifiers, payloads, status, lifecycle timestamps, and notes.

classes.name: ExecutionFilter
classes.description: Contains criteria for filtering execution records during queries, such as identifiers, status, time range, and pagination options.

classes.name: ExecutionDAGEdge
classes.description: Models a parent-to-child relationship between execution nodes for workflow graph representation.

methods.name: GroupExecutionsByRun
methods.description: Groups a list of executions by their RunID, preserving input order within each group.

methods.name: BuildExecutionGraph
methods.description: Constructs nodes, edges, and roots for DAG visualization from a list of executions.
